label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee feast in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00, concealed from the mayor: replacing spoiled bread with at least 200 fresh loaves (201 ultimately verified), installing eight lanterns, and arranging the mayor's timely arrival under the description of a routine lighting and table inspection. Baker knowingly baked and funded bread; neighbour knowingly bought and installed lanterns, carried bread, and agreed to escort the mayor without revealing the celebration. Secretary scheduled the inspection but is not shown knowing about the surprise.
